text:
anya: noticing a buildup of Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1-b since 03:10 UTC, looks like multi-gpu jobs can't find nvlink pairs
lee: saw that too. packing heatmap shows lots of single-GPU nodes scattered across AZs after last night's cost optimizations
pete: can you dump a sample?
anya: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l job=bigtrain -o wide | grep Pending`
```
bigtrain-0   Pending   0/8 nodes  00s
bigtrain-1   Pending   0/8 nodes  00s
```
lee: these require gang scheduling with strict nodeAffinity for nvlink-group: groupA
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled up 4 nodes in ap-southeast1 at 03:04 UTC (policy: cost-balanced)
anya: cost-balanced distributed capacity across AZs; for nvlink co-allocation we need same-rack or same-az packing
clara: we're also seeing warmpool handoff race where nodes get tainted then drained and the gang can't rebind
pete: eviction logs show "AffinityPriority" failures then Evicted: NodeAffinity
```
I0323 03:12:34 scheduler.go:... "Pod bigtrain-0 couldn't be scheduled: requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution -- node affinity"
E0323 03:13:01 kubelet.go: Evicted pod bigtrain-1, reason: NodeAffinity
```
lee: short term: propose flipping autoscaler to "zone-aligned" for ap-southeast1 and disable cost-balanced for 20m to let the binpacker coalesce
anya: +1. add an alert for pending_gang_pods > 3 for 10m while we test
clara: we'll need to watch networking egress costs if zone-aligned forces hot nodes in one AZ; ops has budget for 1 hour windows
ops-bot: action created: INF-3310 - flip autoscaler policy for ap-southeast1 and run a coalesce dry run (assignee: lee)
lee: flipping now (03:22 UTC), will post counts in 8-10m
deploy-bot: autoscaler policy changed in ap-southeast1 to zone-aligned by lee at 03:22 UTC
anya: after 6m pending went from 6 -> 1, evictions dropped to zero
pete: good signal. can we also relax affinity threshold for small_shard jobs from 0.95 -> 0.75 to improve packing for tiny gangs?
clara: relax threshold might add cross-AZ NVLink-less traffic for some distributed trainers, need to run perf sims first
lee: plan: run staging dry-run of threshold relax + coalescer sim, post telemetry (network egress, GPU-util, scheduling latency)
ops-bot: note: manual rollback plan in doc INF-3310 if eviction_count increases or pending_gang_pods > 5
anya: thanks. follow-ups: ticket to add NVLink topology awareness into binpacker (heuristic: prefer co-located slots before cross-AZ allocation), and a telemetry dashboard for gang scheduling blocked reasons
clara: filing that as ARCH-1205 after the sim results
lee: will keep autoscaler zone-aligned for the 30m window and monitor cost delta
anya: excellent. thanks everyone
